scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @yellow-flow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @yellow-flow/core && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @yellow-flow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @yellow-flow/core && vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @yellow-flow/protocol && npm run build --workspace @yellow-flow/core && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
